about_short_description.short_description: Upwave is an analytics platform for brand advertising.

product.name: Brand Lift
product.description: Measures campaign performance and analyzes tactics to improve key performance indicators related to brand awareness and purchase intent.

product.name: Brand Optimization
product.description: Provides actionable insights during campaigns to identify overperforming and underperforming tactics for budget and traffic reallocation.

product.name: Brand Reach
product.description: Validates reach, frequency, and scale of campaigns among targeted brand-specific audiences beyond basic demographics.

product.name: Bayes AI Agent
product.description: An AI-driven agent that automates complex analyses, generates insights, and produces reports for brand measurement and optimization.
